Lib Dem leader promises tax cuts, faces party challenges

Liberal Democrat leader Ed Davey has promised to raise tax thresholds for millions of people if the UK rejoins the EU single market. He made the pledge in a speech to his party conference. One report described the party as 'a dead party walking', while another suggested the party 'needs more oddballs'.
